mode: Window-free egui and lint checks only. No desktop, native-window or screenshot-preview launches.

focused_gui.scope: Classic light/dark layer-list scrolling with fixed name/opacity controls; 18-layer document, selection without history, visibility and ordering on stable layer identities, close/reopen without history; forced repeated layout passes. Focus loss during layer selection commits the edited name to its original owner with one undoable entry.

limits: No rendered/native visual qualification under the user restriction. Classic owns its list presentation; host dispatches existing engine actions and retains name/opacity commit semantics. Studio presentation remains separate. Real layer thumbnails, complete layer interactions and reference parity remain open.
